# Lyrenza Sao Paulo Jardins

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Sao Paulo Jardins is in Sao Paulo, Brazil, in the South America region.
Facilities: Indoor pool; business lounge; spa; chef-led restaurant. Pool or water-facility hours: 06:00-22:00.
